title: 高松宮記念の後に・有終バクシン！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While not by 1,000 lengths, Sakura Bakushin O secures victory over Nishino Flower.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I start to diverge from the Bakushin Road, Sakura Bakushin O begins to question my intentions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wanting to quell these concerns, I propose she competes in the Hakodate Sprint Stakes, CBC Sho, and Centaur Stakes—their combined lengths totaling 3,600 meters!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Captivated by the grand distance of 3,600 meters, Sakura Bakushin O is eager to finish all three races.
